name: Satou Asami
source: Asami used to be [url=https://vndb.org/c63689]Takuya[/url]'s senpai and his mentor as the school's chemistry club president. Since last year, she has graduated from Miyanomori High School and now she is enrolled at an university in a different town. She was the only scientist that was able to turn [url=https://vndb.org/c34009]female Takuya[/url] back into [url=https://vndb.org/c17365]a man[/url] again. Once again, her expertise in chemistry is needed because Takuya has this year as well gotten himself turned into [url=https://vndb.org/c63690]a woman[/url]. But since Takuya had lost contact with her ever since she graduated, he might not be able to find her in time for her to make a cure. Instead, Takuya might have to rely only on Asami's old rival, [url=https://vndb.org/c63687]Chisato[/url], as she is the only scientist that is reachable at the moment.
